analyst_assumptions.fx: Transaction-only illustration at September inferred translation reference 1.139206 USD per EUR, not current spot or actual settlement rate.
analyst_assumptions.financing_costs: Net issue proceeds estimated by issuer at EUR 794.2 million; accepted tender premium USD 6.996310 million. Additional tender fees of USD 1 million and coupon cash reserve of USD 15 million are assumptions.
analyst_assumptions.settlement_status: Issuance confirmed completed November 2. Tender acceptance confirmed November 5. Actual tender settlement and maturity repayment not separately confirmed in reviewed primary sources.
analyst_assumptions.Leistung: Completed acquisition announced November 4. Deduct preliminary USD 40 million cash cost. Do not add invented separate EBITDA or synergies beyond forecast combined growth.
analyst_assumptions.investment: USD 33.11 million separate asset credit for pending USD 43 million equity-method investment sale; 23% realization/tax allowance is illustrative, not verified tax basis.
analyst_assumptions.benefits: USD 83.706 million gross non-US and postemployment claims from annual filing, no offset for assets in different plans. Annual proxy, not exact updated actuarial liability.
analyst_assumptions.shares: September legal shares 260.437063 million issued less 127.436400 million treasury plus 0.678 million quarterly dilution proxy equals 133.678663 million.
analyst_assumptions.forecast: Historical financial series and forecast structure reused from A326; common WACC 9.361011%, tax 23%, physical depreciation 2.1%, capex floor 3.0–3.2%, marginal NWC 20%, incremental capital returns 12/15/20%. All forecasts are bounded estimates, not published guidance.
analyst_assumptions.inverse: Price-matching growth path produces negative first-year FCFF of USD 576.1 million. Mathematical diagnostic only; funding not validated.
analyst_assumptions.risk: Stress uses margins lower by 2 percentage points, NWC 30% and additional USD 100 million year-one outflow; no assertion of an actual announced charge.
